# DSteele

::: {.hero-subtitle}
A 3D spectral-element / finite-layer model for pavement response under moving loads
:::

DSteele was developed to simulate layered flexible-pavement response under vehicle loads traveling at constant speed, with Traffic Speed Deflectometer (TSD) applications as a central motivation.

[Start with the DSteele overview](../posts/dsteele-overview/index.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}
:::
